topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I’ve been reflecting on a recent experience, and I can’t help but see the silver lining. It turns out, the invention I was working on was already patented. At first, it was a bit of a setback. But the more I thought about it, the more I realized how affirming this was. It validated the innovation and potential of my idea. It means I was on the right track, thinking along the lines of what experts in the field are recognizing as valuable. Now, I’m even more motivated to refine my concept, to find those unique angles that could set it apart. This isn’t a stop sign; it’s a checkpoint that’s pushed me to think deeper and aim higher.
